reviews.body: Love this. One thing on the event name.
LGTM. Let's make this the standard.

comments.author: bob
comments.body: The first version had `log.warning(f"Refund of {amount_cents} rejected for charge {charge_id}")`. With an f-string the message is different every time, so Datadog can't group it and we're back to regexes. Event name should be a constant snake_case string, values as kwargs.

comments.author: carol
comments.body: Yep, muscle memory. Fixed, and I'll put the rule in the module docstring.

comments.author: alice
comments.body: +1, and anything with customer data goes through `redact()`. Let's hold every new log line to this.
